children: Saba Capital Management, L.P., a 10% Owner, reported purchasing 169,040 shares of Destiny Tech100 common stock indirectly through funds and accounts it manages on Nov. 25, 2026, at $23.35 per share, for a total purchase amount of $3,947,084. Saba Capital Management, L.P. indirectly owns 5,187,250 shares following the transaction. Boaz R. Weinstein is the managing member of Saba Capital Management GP, LLC, the general partner of Saba Capital Management, L.P.
